facts.fact: Subscribers: 25,088 satellite internet subscriptions at 2026-03-31, per the Communications Authority of Kenya Q3 FY2025/26 report (+11.4% on the previous quarter, which had 22,282 Starlink users); Starlink Internet Services Kenya held 24,999.
Starlink Internet Services Kenya sells satellite broadband in Kenya with 24,999 active subscribers, 0.9% of fixed market share, per the CA; a 100Mbps residential plan has been introduced.
Amazon (Project Kuiper) has applied for a satellite internet licence in Kenya; none is stated as granted.
